questions.stem:
Trevor, who is not an Australian citizen, is to be released from a NSW prison after serving a sentence of two years.
On his release, can Trevor be deported to his country of origin?

options.A: No, as he was sentenced by a NSW court and deportation is a federal matter.
options.B: No, as the deportation should have been determined at the time of sentencing.
options.C: Yes, as deportation can occur after serving a sentence of one year or more.
options.D: Yes, as the judge can use discretion to order deportation as part of the sentence.
